content.title: VRSK Q3 Deep Dive: Weather-Driven Slowdown and AI Strategy Shape Outlook
content.summary: Insurance data analytics provider Verisk Analytics (NASDAQ:VRSK) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 5.9% year on year to $768.3 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.07 billion at the midpoint came in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.72 per share was 1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
